name: ansvar-cmmc
description: Run CMMC Level 1 and Level 2 self-assessments under 32 CFR Part 170 with cited NIST SP 800-171 requirements and objectives, human-attested evidence, the engine's result and status, the POA&M Level 2 allows, SPRS inputs and the affirmation. A self-assessment aid, not a C3PAO assessment or legal advice. Includes using-ansvar for cited legal and standards questions. Try: 'Using Ansvar, run a CMMC Level 1 self-assessment for our company.'
